name: proto-blocks/cadco-product-children
title: Cadco Product Children
description: A scrollable row of the products that name this one as their Parent Product — its accessories. Drawn with the catalogue's own card. Appears only when Products → Display Settings gives children their own row; its heading is set there too.

surface.label: Section background
surface.help: Pale blue by default so this row and Related Products below it read as two sections rather than one long one.
